title: Select the link in the card
goal: Mark all links in the order card equally, covering links embedded in paragraphs.
summary: A space connects the parent range and the target selector. As long as the target is within this range, it can be matched across multiple layers of elements.
tasks: Use the descendant selector to select a in the .order area.
Set the text color of the order link to #6b3f87 and reset the font to 600. The service desk link retains its original style.
hint: Use a space between .order and a. Check whether the "duty time" hidden in the paragraph also has the style applied.

example.note: Some of the pictures in the product catalog are next to the catalog container, and some are wrapped in the product card. This selector can add rounded corners to images in the directory.
